title: StoryMap
description: The story map: the settled weave laid across the article's sections. Each beat names the material it uses; the map writes no prose.

deck.description: The deck printed under the headline

topPhoto.description: The filename of the photo the article prints at its top, one of the photos offered

gapNote.description: The line at the top of the map, present only when the record cannot carry part of the story, a player cannot be placed, or a link the weave lacks was seen

players.description: The roster players the line raises, by name

sections.description: The sections the article uses, in the order it prints them

heading.description: The heading the article prints over the section; empty for a section that prints none

job.description: What the section does to the question, in one sentence

id.description: The beat's id, its own across the whole map, such as b1

kind.description: What the beat puts on the page

material.description: The material the beat uses, named: the id of a document in <RECORD>; the speaker and the line; or the ledger entry

players.description: The roster players the beat shows, by name

card.description: When the beat prints a document as a card: the document's id in <RECORD>

connection.description: The id of the settled weave's connection that lands in this beat; each live connection lands in one beat

filename.description: The photo's filename, as the photos offered give it

beat.description: The id of the beat the photo sits beside; left out for a photo that sits with its people

dropped.description: Each slot the story does not use

reason.description: Why the story does not use it, in one line

leftOut.description: The material considered and not used, each in a beat's shape

id.description: The beat's id, its own across the whole map, such as b1

kind.description: What the beat puts on the page

material.description: The material the beat uses, named: the id of a document in <RECORD>; the speaker and the line; or the ledger entry

players.description: The roster players the beat shows, by name

card.description: When the beat prints a document as a card: the document's id in <RECORD>

connection.description: The id of the settled weave's connection that lands in this beat; each live connection lands in one beat

expectedLength.description: The writer's estimate of the article's length in words, from what the map holds

weaveChanges.description: What the map changed in the weave to fit in each change the director made at the story meeting; empty when the director changed nothing and left no note

source.description: The id of the director's change in <SETTLED_WEAVE>, such as E3, or "note" for a change the director's note from the meeting asks for, when the prompt holds that note: the approval note marked arc-selection in <DIRECTOR_GUIDANCE>

change.description: What the map changed, in one line
